reason: A new seller with no reviews and no photos of the actual wheels, and I can pick up refurbished sets on Marketplace or eBay all day for less. I'd message them to haggle, but I wouldn't hand over cash on a first look.
objection: No reviews, so I've no idea if these are properly repaired or just painted over a bend. And £300 isn't far off what I can haggle a decent used set down to on Marketplace.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the actual set in person before paying, with a fitment check on my car and the price down to about £220-£240.
